Both CoreWeave and Nebius are seeing extraordinary AI infrastructure demand.
The real question is whether they can build capacity fast enough, and cheaply enough, to convert that demand into revenue without overwhelming their balance sheets.
CoreWeave arguably has the stronger visibility because of its $129 billion backlog, which helps explain why BofA sees more upside there.
But that opportunity comes with more obvious funding pressure.
Nebius may have a slightly cleaner near-term financing position, yet its growth thesis still depends on bringing new capacity online on schedule.
